Welcome to our Website

Dinkar Alloys is offering Hastelloy C22 Fittings, Hastelloy C276 Round Bars, Nickel 200 Forged Fittings, Titanium Pipe Fittings, Inconel Alloy 600 Pipes, Duplex Steel Pipes, Alloy Steel Pipes, Alloy 20 Pipes, Stainless Steel Products, Buttweld Pipe Fittings, Socket Weld Fittings, and Perforated Sheets etc. Our array of products is designed from the optimum quality raw materials as per the national and international quality norms. Our products are also available in customized specifications according to the exact requirement of the patrons. As a trusted Manufacturer, Exporter and Supplier of these products, we ensure that we make them available to our clients at the best industry prices in the minimum delivery period possible.
